produced_by: Codex frontier planner using the LocalLab planner template

slices.title: Add a redacting public-boundary detector and regression probes
slices.goal: Implement the shared offline detector for high-confidence private paths, private-source markers, and credential-shaped tokens; prove rejected examples, safe near-misses, and redacted diagnostics; and bind the probes into the repository test route.
acceptance_criteria: The detector reports stable rule identifiers and one-based line numbers without returning or printing matched material
Rules cover file URIs, macOS/Linux/Windows user-home paths, llm-wiki-ranjib: references, and credential-shaped GitHub, OpenAI, and AWS tokens
Regression probes reject one example per rule family and accept safe near-misses used in ordinary technical prose
The repository test route executes the regression probes and passes

slices.title: Enforce public boundaries across Markdown post sources
slices.goal: Extend the existing content-model validator to run the shared public-boundary detector against every Markdown post, including drafts, and report only file, line, and rule identity on failure.
acceptance_criteria: Every Markdown file under content/posts is scanned before draft filtering
Failures identify the relative source path, line number, and stable rule identifier without echoing matched content
The repository lint route passes on the current corpus

slices.title: Enforce public boundaries across rendered post HTML
slices.goal: Extend the existing rendered-post validator to run the shared public-boundary detector against generated post HTML so template or rendering transformations cannot expose private material unnoticed.
acceptance_criteria: Every generated post index.html is scanned when the rendered page is verified
Failures identify the rendered path, line number, and stable rule identifier without echoing matched content
The repository lint route passes on the current rendered site
